title: Luminex Assay Bead and Antibody Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol provides sample and reagents to 2 96 well plates according to the [Luminex MagPlex® Microspheres kit](https://www.luminexcorp.com/magplex-microspheres/#overview). Column 1 of the source isopak 1 is dispensed into rows A, C, E, G of the destination plate 1 in columns 1 and 2. Column 2 of the source isopak is dispensed into rows A, C, E, G of the destination plate 1 in columns 3 and 4, etc. Column 1 of the source isopak 2 is dispensed into rows B, D, F, H of the destination plate 1 in columns 1 and 2, etc. This is then repeated for destination plate 2. Tips are removed from rows B, D, F, H of the tipracks on slot 10 and 11 to allow for the multi-channel pipette to access the isopaks. The tiprack on slot 9 should be a full tip rack. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Sample Volume`: Specify the sample volume to be replicated in microliters. * `Use middle two columns?`: Specify whether using the middle two columns in source isopaks. See below for deck map if selected. If selected, the protocol will pause after the first 96 plate is filled to prompt the user to replace the alternate tip rack on slot 11. * `Antibody Volume`: Specify the sample volume to be replicated in microliters. * `SA-PE Volume`: Specify the SA-PE volume to be replicated in microliters. * `P300 Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P300 Multi-Channel Pipette. ---

steps.title: Prepare tip racks and pipette
steps.instruction: Set up tip racks: place a full tip rack in slot 9, and remove tips from rows B, D, F, H of the tip racks in slots 10 and 11 so the multi‑channel pipette can access the isopaks. Mount the P300 multi‑channel pipette on the specified mount (left or right) and enter the user‑defined Sample Volume, Antibody Volume, SA‑PE Volume, and whether to use the middle two columns.

steps.title: Dispense samples to plates
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel pipette, transfer the defined sample volume from the source isopaks to the two 96‑well destination plates following the layout: source isopak 1 → rows A, C, E, G of destination plate 1 in columns 1‑2, then columns 3‑4, etc.; source isopak 2 → rows B, D, F, H of destination plate 1 in columns 1‑2, etc.; repeat the same pattern for destination plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Dispense from isopak 1 to rows A, C, E, G of plate 1 columns 1‑2, then continue across subsequent column pairs.
Dispense from isopak 2 to rows B, D, F, H of plate 1 columns 1‑2, then continue across subsequent column pairs.
Repeat the above two dispensing patterns for destination plate 2.

steps.title: Add beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of beads to every well of both 96‑well plates.

steps.title: Incubate after beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for incubation; resume when the user selects “resume” in the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Add sample (second transfer)
steps.instruction: Transfer sample from the source isopaks to the wells according to the same scheme described in the dispensing step.

steps.title: Incubate after sample
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for incubation; resume when the user selects “resume” in the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Add antibody
steps.instruction: Add the user‑specified antibody volume to every well of both 96‑well plates.

steps.title: Incubate after antibody
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for incubation; resume when the user selects “resume” in the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Add SA‑PE
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL of SA‑PE to every well of both 96‑well plates.
